positive: Funny game, my friends and i die laughing when we all explode into tiny cats at once
I actually love the chaos. exploding into multiple cats feels like a reward sometimes, not a punishment

Im kinda torn about this game. The world is beautiful, theres so many secret areas and floating islands to explore, and the flying mechanic is super smooth. But the cheese explosion thing is really rng sometimes, like i ate one cheese and nothing happened, then next thing i exploded into 15 cats… also i keep bumping into walls as tiny cats, feels unfair. Still, its funny and addictive, i keep coming back.

Fantasy Gremlins is prob the funniest MMO ive played in ages. The little details like cheese crumbs sticking to your fur or cats tripping over each other are genius. But omg, the tiny cat phase can last way too long if u explode too much and it makes grinding quests super annoying. Maybe some option to grow back faster? Anyway, i cant stop laughing every time my cat explodes mid-flight, its chaotic but fun chaos!
medium: Cheese crafting system is neat, but way too confusing for new players. needs tutorial.

I rly love the idea of being a flying cat in a fantasy world, its so uniqe. The cheese exploding thing is hilarious at first but after like 10 explosions in a row, it gets frustrating coz u lose all ur progress as a tiny cat. Also, tiny cats feel soooo weak and slow… wish there was a way to catch up faster. Still, i cant stop laughing when my friends and i all explode in the air at the same time lol

The MMO part is super fun, meeting other cats and forming little flying squads is amazing. But somtimes the game lags sooo much when too many people are eating cheese at once, it kinda ruins the fun. Also the tutorial didnt explain how some cheeses make u split into dozens of cats and others dont… very confusing. Overall i enjoy it but its a bit rough around the edges.
negative: I get lost so easily, the map is not very clear. tiny cats get even worse.
AI cats are unpredictable, sometimes they fly straight into cheese mines… i dunno if that’s bug or feature.
I dont like that you can’t carry more than one big cheese. ruins my strategy

summaries.positive: Players love the game's hilarious and chaotic gameplay, especially finding the unique mechanic of exploding into tiny cats to be a fun, rewarding experience. They praise the beautiful world, smooth flying, and humorous details, describing the game as addictive despite its quirks.
